remarks: Welcome to this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo, offering the perfect blend of modern living and convenience. Situated in a prime location, this home features an open-concept living space that's perfect for both relaxation and entertaining. Large windows flood the space with natural light, leading you to your private balcony where you can enjoy breathtaking sunset views over the tranquil Norwalk River. The well-appointed kitchen seamlessly flows into the living and dining areas, creating an ideal setting for hosting friends or enjoying a quiet evening at home. Both bedrooms are generously sized, with the primary suite featuring an en-suite bathroom and ample closet space. The second bedroom is perfect for guests, a home office, or a cozy retreat. Located just minutes from the East Norwalk Train Station, commuting is a breeze, whether you're heading into the city or exploring the local area. You're also within walking distance to the vibrant South Norwalk (SONO) district, where you'll find an array of dining, shopping, and nightlife options, including the upscale SONO Collection Mall. With easy access to I-95, all your shopping, entertainment, and commuting needs are at your fingertips. This condo offers a perfect combination of serene river views, modern amenities, and an unbeatable location, making it the ideal place to call home.
